chunks: And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā asked him about a man who forgets while he is fasting and has intercourse with his wife. He said:
He should perform ghusl (ritual bath), and there is nothing upon him.

The author of this book—may Allah have mercy on him—said: And that applies in the month of Ramadan and other than it, and making up the fast is not obligatory in it. Thus it has been narrated from the Imams عليهم السلام.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ: the Imams, peace be upon them
key_terms.وَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no penalty or liability upon him
key_terms.يَنْسَىٰ: forgets; indicating the act occurred unintentionally

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgetfully has intercourse while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who has intercourse forgetfully while fasting. It states that ghusl (ritual bath) is required, but there is no sin, expiation, or liability upon him, and the compiler adds that no qada' is required either, whether in Ramadan or otherwise.
